title: An Empirical Evaluation of Cross-City POI Recommendation on a Large-Scale Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.27840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-city point-of-interest (POI) recommendation is crucial for navigating unfamiliar urban environments, yet its progress has historically been constrained by data limitations. Using the recently proposed large-scale benchmark Trip World, we empirically re-examine whether conclusions drawn on small prior benchmarks still hold under worldwide coverage, low home-destination region overlap, and large, semantically rich POI inventories. Our evaluation surfaces three bottlenecks of representative state-of-the-art methods: (1) hometown-aware models appear to rely more on destination-region priors than on user-specific preference transfer; (2) their accuracy-efficiency trade-off degrades at this scale, where the simplest model is among the strongest; and (3) existing mechanisms for integrating semantic metadata yield little benefit. translated_title: 大规模基准上跨城市兴趣点（POI）推荐的实证评估
translated_abstract: 跨城市兴趣点（POI）推荐对于在陌生城市环境中导航至关重要，但其进展历来受限于数据不足。利用最近提出的大规模基准 Trip World，我们实证性地重新审视了以往基于小型基准得出的结论，在覆盖全球、家乡与目的地地区重叠度低、以及POI库存庞大且语义丰富的条件下是否依然成立。我们的评估揭示了代表性最先进方法的三个瓶颈：（1）家乡感知模型似乎更多依赖目的地地区的先验信息，而非用户特定的偏好迁移；（2）在此规模下，这些方法的准确率-效率权衡出现退化，其中最简单的模型反而跻身最强者之列；（3）现有整合语义元数据的机制收效甚微。我们进一步加入了一项针对从下一POI推荐方法改造而来的智能体方法的诊断性试点研究，发现……
tldr: 在大规模跨城市POI推荐基准Trip World上，现有最先进方法暴露出三大瓶颈：家乡感知模型依赖目的地先验而非用户偏好迁移、准确率-效率权衡在大规模场景下退化、语义元数据整合机制收效甚微。
en_tdlr: On the large-scale cross-city POI recommendation benchmark Trip World, state-of-the-art methods reveal three bottlenecks: hometown-aware models rely on destination priors rather than user preference transfer, accuracy-efficiency trade-offs degrade at scale, and existing semantic metadata integration mechanisms yield little benefit.
